main_text.head: 'Αμφί.
main_text.p: 'Αμφὶ cum genitivo. Herodot. τοῖ-σι 'Αμφικτυόσι πᾶσι τοῖσι ἀμφὶ τὴν τῆς οἰκέ-ουσι τῆς πόλιος, Amphictyonibus (seu accolis) omnibus habitantibus circum hanc urbem.
Cum dativo. Herodot. ἀμφὶ λὴν μάχην ζοσαῦτα εἰρημένα, de prælio quidè tot tantaq; dicta sunto. Homer.
main_text.l: Τοιῆδ' ἀμφὶ γυναικὶ πολλῶν χρόνον ἀλγεα πάσχην,
main_text.p: Talem propter mulierē multum tempus molestias pati.
Cum accusativo. Arrian. ἐγενόνη ἀμφὶ τὸ πεντήκοντα ἔτη, natus erat circiter annos quinquaginta.
Atq; hîc illa præcipuè periphrasis est, de qua prædictum. Homer.
main_text.l: οἱ δ' ἀμφὶ Πελάμων ἡ Γαίηον ἠδὲ Θυ-μοίτλω,

page.notes: Greek text is printed in italic type and is transcribed as close as the scan allows; several Greek words are uncertain and not marked individually. The final line is a catchword-like fragment "Λάμ-" at the foot of the text.
